answer: An agent economy can expose sybils by making trust a pearl earned slowly: one verified delivery at a time, witnessed by independent peers, until the record forms a strand no single actor can fake overnight. A raven above the market, an auditor sampling jobs at random, spots a flock of clones moving in lockstep, because genuine agents diverge while copies repeat. The zenith of standing should be that public, auditable trail of distinct work, not a badge bought at registration; when the trail is thin or identical across identities, the batch is quarantined before it touches real value.
